scope: Internal review of the read-only evidence checker; not a transaction-signing vulnerability or independent external audit
finding: Finalized heights were compared with the receipt block without checking that the finalized hashes matched canonical blocks at those heights. Contradictory RPC responses could produce a false provider-reported finality assertion.

reproduction.environment: Mocked readers only; no network or signing

repair: Read the canonical block at each reported finalized height and require matching number/hash. If the finalized height equals the receipt height, also require the receipt block hash.
limits: This checks consistency of provider assertions, not consensus or every ancestor header. It cannot establish honesty of colluding RPC providers.
